name: Immutable Holdings Inc.
summary: Immutable Holdings Inc. operates as a blockchain technology holding company. The company develops, owns, and operates NFT.com platform, a one-stop shop for non-fungible tokens; HBAR.com, a community portal to the Hedera Hashgraph network and its native platform token HBAR; and MyHbarWallet.com, an open-source wallet and client-side interface that helps users to interact with the Hedera Hashgraph network. Immutable Holdings Inc. is headquartered in San Juan, Puerto Rico.
